notes.title: Xbox Release Date
notes.notes:
[h3]Gauls![/h3]

We are happy to announce that Gallic Wars: Battle Simulator Xbox port is almost ready and will be released on 16.06.2021! The game is already available on PC and [url=https://www.nintendo.com/games/detail/gallic-wars-battle-simulator-switch/]Nintendo Switch[/url].

[i]Yours, Gaming Factory S.A. Team.[/i]
